disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to, or conviction of, a felony or criminal offense involving fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: enters a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to or is convicted of a felony or a criminal offense involving fraud

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, misrepresentation, deceit, or material misstatement of fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: procures or attempts to procure a license under this chapter or Chapter 1102 for the license holder by fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit or by making a material misstatement of fact in an application for a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to honor, within a reasonable time, a payment issued to the commission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to honor, within a reasonable time, a payment issued to the commission after the commission has sent by certified mail a request for payment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide, within a reasonable time, information requested by the commission relating to a complaint.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to provide, within a reasonable time, information requested by the commission that relates to a formal or informal complaint to the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to surrender to the owner, without just cause, a document or instrument in the license holder's possession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to surrender to the owner, without just cause, a document or instrument that is requested by the owner and that is in the license holder's possession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to consider market conditions for the specific geographic area in which the license holder is providing a service.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to consider market conditions for the specific geographic area in which the license holder is providing a service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the commission within 30 days of a final conviction or plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or fraud offense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to notify the commission, not later than the 30th day after the date of a final conviction or the entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding or violating this chapter or Chapter 1102.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disregards or violates this chapter or Chapter 1102.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in misrepresentation, dishonesty, or fraud when selling, buying, trading, or leasing real property in the name of the license holder, spouse, or close relative.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engages in misrepresentation, dishonesty, or fraud when selling, buying, trading, or leasing real property in the name of: (A) the license holder; (B) the license holder's spouse; or (C) a person related to the license holder within the first degree by consanguinity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to produce on request, within a reasonable time, documents, books, or records relating to a real estate transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails or refuses to produce on request, within a reasonable time, for inspection by the commission or a commission representative, a document, book, or record that is in the license holder's possession and relates to a real estate transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to use a contract form required by the commission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to use a contract form required by the commission under Section 1101.155.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting negligently or incompetently while engaged in real estate brokerage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acts negligently or incompetently

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that is dishonest, in bad faith, or demonstrates untrustworthiness.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engages in conduct that is dishonest or in bad faith or that demonstrates untrustworthiness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material misrepresentation to a potential buyer concerning a significant defect known to the license holder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: makes a material misrepresentation to a potential buyer concerning a significant defect, including a latent structural defect, known to the license holder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false promise likely to influence a person to enter into an agreement when the license holder is unable or does not intend to keep the promise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: makes a false promise that is likely to influence a person to enter into an agreement when the license holder is unable or does not intend to keep the promise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through agents, advertising, or otherwise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: pursues a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or makes false promises through an agent or sales agent, through advertising, or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make clear to all parties the party for whom the license holder is acting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to make clear to all parties to a real estate transaction the party for whom the license holder is acting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving compensation from more than one party without full knowledge and consent of all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: receives compensation from more than one party to a real estate transaction without the full knowledge and consent of all parties to the transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to properly account for or remit money received belonging to another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails within a reasonable time to properly account for or remit money that is received by the license holder and that belongs to another person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling money that belongs to another person with the license holder's own money.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commingles money that belongs to another person with the license holder's own money

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission or fee to or dividing a commission with a non-license holder (except out-of-state brokers).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: pays a commission or a fee to or divides a commission or a fee with a person other than a license holder or a real estate broker or sales agent licensed in another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to specify a definite termination date not subject to prior notice in a service contract (other than property management).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to specify a definite termination date that is not subject to prior notice in a contract, other than a contract to perform property management services, in which the license holder agrees to perform services for which a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, receiving, or charging an undisclosed commission, rebate, or direct profit on an expenditure made for a principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepts, receives, or charges an undisclosed commission, rebate, or direct profit on an expenditure made for a principal

disciplinary_grounds.quote: negotiates or attempts to negotiate the sale, exchange, or lease of real property with an owner, landlord, buyer, or tenant with knowledge that that person is a party to an outstanding written contract that grants exclusive agency to another broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or causing to be published a misleading or deceptive advertisement, or one that implies a sales agent is responsible for operation of the brokerage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: publishes or causes to be published an advertisement that: (A) misleads or is likely to deceive the public; (B) tends to create a misleading impression; (C) implies that a sales agent is responsible for the operation of the broker's real estate brokerage business

definition_quote.value: a person who, in exchange for a commission or other valuable consideration or with the expectation of receiving a commission or other valuable consideration, performs for another person one of the following acts: (i) sells, exchanges, purchases, or leases real estate; (ii) offers to sell, exchange, purchase, or lease real estate; (iii) negotiates or attempts to negotiate the listing, sale, exchange, purchase, or lease of real estate; (iv) lists or offers, attempts, or agrees to list real estate for sale, lease, or exchange; (v) auctions or offers, attempts, or agrees to auction real estate; (vi) deals in options on real estate; (vii) aids or offers or attempts to aid in locating or obtaining real estate for purchase or lease; (viii) procures or assists in procuring a prospect to effect the sale, exchange, or lease of real estate; (ix) procures or assists in procuring property to effect the sale, exchange, or lease of real estate; (x) controls the acceptance or deposit of rent from a resident of a single-family residential real property unit; (xi) provides a written analysis, opinion, or conclusion relating to the estimated price of real property; (xii) advises or offers advice to an owner of real estate concerning the negotiation or completion of a short sale
definition_quote.quote: means a person who, in exchange for a commission or other valuable consideration or with the expectation of receiving a commission or other valuable consideration, performs for another person one of the following acts

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A broker who complies with the written consent requirements of Section 1101.559 may appoint: (1) a license holder associated with the broker to communicate with and carry out instructions of one party to a real estate transaction; and (2) another license holder associated with the broker to communicate with and carry out instructions of any other party to the transaction.
